title: Library Event Flyer
label: 問3
passageHtml:
Make Something Saturday

West Park Library invites teenagers to join one of our free workshops.

WorkshopTimeAgeLimit
Podcast Basics10:00–11:3013–1812 people
Photo Stories11:00–12:3015–188 people
Mini Magazine13:30–15:3013–1816 people

Registration closes on 18 July. You may register for only one workshop. Bring headphones for Podcast Basics. Cameras will be lent to Photo Stories participants. All materials for Mini Magazine are provided.

Cancellations made by 20 July allow another person to take the place.

questions.question: Which workshop can a 14-year-old attend in the afternoon?
questions.reason_ja: 年齢と時間帯の両条件を満たすのはMini Magazineです。

questions.question: What do Photo Stories participants NOT need to bring?
questions.evidence: Cameras will be lent to Photo Stories participants.
questions.reason_ja: カメラは貸し出されるため持参不要です。

questions.question: Why should a participant cancel by 20 July?
questions.evidence: Cancellations made by 20 July allow another person to take the place.
questions.reason_ja: 期限内のキャンセルは他の参加者に枠を譲るためです。

questions.question: Which statement is true?
options: Each person may join two workshops
Every workshop accepts the same number
Registration ends before the cancellation deadline
questions.answer: Registration ends before the cancellation deadline
questions.evidence: Registration closes on 18 July; cancellations by 20 July.
questions.reason_ja: 18日締切、20日キャンセル期限なので、登録締切が先です。
